platform: Duda website builder (irp.cdn-website.com assets); brochure site, no e-commerce catalog
est_products: Official site lists ~45 models by series name only on /products (no per-SKU pages); sitemap.xml has only 4 pages. Sonic Electric Airzone collection: 45 products.
sku_format_match: yes - official /products page and retailers use the same model codes (SE90PL2, SES80, SEPD300, SNPD100MHL2...). On Sonic Electric 10/12 sample SKUs match exactly; SNP80H and SNP100 are sold as combined listings with SKUs 'SNP80H-100H' and 'SNP80-100'.

sample_tests.note: not an exact SKU on Sonic Electric; closest listing SKU 'SNP80H-100H' (handle airzone-snp80h-80-cfm-quiet-ac-motor-ventilation-fan-with-humidity) - combined SNP80H/SNP100H product

alternatives.name: Sonic Electric
alternatives.notes: HTTP 200, 45 products, vendor 'Airzone Fans', one variant per product with sku = AirZone model code. Usually 1 image (some 2) per product on cdn.shopify.com; a few images are shared between related models (e.g. SE110PHL2 uses an SE90PL2 image, SNP series share one image, SQ-LED-LK and SE-GU24-LK share one). No anti-bot seen.

alternatives.name: BuyRite Electric
alternatives.notes: HTTP 200 on /products.json and product .json; SE90PL2 found with sku 'SE90PL2' and image SE90PL2.png. Full-store pagination needed to isolate AirZone (vendor 'AirZone Fans'). Use to fill gaps / cross-check.

alternatives.name: Official spec sheets (PDF)
alternatives.notes: Series-level PDF spec sheets linked from /products; contain drawings/photos, not per-SKU image files. Only 6 series photos on the official site (e.g. SNP+50+80+100-1-2880w.jpg, SED+400jpg-2880w.jpg).

recommended_strategy: Official site has no per-SKU images. Harvest Sonic Electric https://sonicelectric.com/collections/airzone/products.json?limit=250 (single page), match variants[].sku exactly (case-insensitive, strip spaces/hyphens as fallback); map SNP80H/SNP100 etc. to the combined 'SNP80H-100H'/'SNP80-100' listings via prefix match. Fill remaining gaps from BuyRite Electric products.json filtered by vendor 'AirZone Fans'. Take product.images[0].src (Shopify CDN; add &width= if resizing needed).
blockers: Official manufacturer site is a brochure with series-level images only; no per-SKU imagery. Retailer images sometimes reused across related models.
